scope: Acquire one bounded directory graph and its target FILE_NAME inventories through the same supplied RegionReader/source/window/profile/epoch. Compare exact original index-name tuples with the owning target filename instances. This is exact observed correspondence, not collation, lookup, complete namespace/tree/content, native worker/public admission or original0.1.0 completion.
ownership: Use existing ntfs_capture Observer for all source controls, MFT addressing, read/retain/overlap/final rereads, FILE/list parsing and target closure. Add a private ntfs_membership request/collector only where its actual comparison/output responsibility needs a separate translation unit. Reuse collect_ntfs_filenames and existing directory/portable decoders. No second source opener, parser, command registry, process host or filesystem framework. Keep NtfsSnapshotKind and all current native/public forms unchanged in this private unit. Use a small private typed edge output from ntfs_directory_detail, and an actual membership comparison/source callback seam. Preserve existing old-mode output/read order and avoid parsing projected JSON as the source of names.
controls: NtfsMembershipRequest owns the existing NtfsDirectoryRequest and a distinct-target ordinal limit1..256(default64). Copy every control before the first callback; invalid controls/reader refuse before any callback. Existing root-reference0 discovery and full nonzero-sequence references, source/version/window and all global capture/directory limits remain unchanged. Target limits do not guarantee completion when another global quota is reached. No automatic limit/deadline growth.
order: Complete usable bootstrap/MFT/Volume validation and the existing directory graph first. Only a complete index proceeds to target acquisition. Preserve every nonterminal edge in its existing encounter order. Visit distinct target ordinals in first-edge encounter order, retaining the exact full reference; duplicate equal references use one membership-phase inventory. A different sequence for an already seen ordinal is stale/conflicting evidence with no replacement or retry. After target comparison, use the same original ordered exact reread phase for every newly retained source region.
target: Address every target FILE through the completed validated MFT map and its initialized/data limits with checked ordinal*record_size and complete split-run coverage. Require protected FILE/fixup/attribute framing, supported in-use flags1/3, nonzero matching sequence, base_reference0 and exact optional on-record ordinal. Existing mapping-error policy remains conservative. Do not follow an index reference as an extension base, guess contiguous storage or use the mirror as fallback. Extra reads of already observed logical records across bootstrap/directory/target phases are allowed only through that same validated mapping, counted globally and checked for overlap byte agreement; this prototype does not require a new general record cache.
names: For each valid target, acquire its existing resident or fully initialized ordinary nonresident ATTRIBUTE_LIST under the same global source/list bounds. Use context/base/instance/original-protected-base-hash binding and collect_ntfs_filenames; fetch only its validated complete missing extension-reference set, with finite progress and exact full owner/sequence/instance checks. Validate present names before publishing dependencies. Every added FILE/list region joins the global retained/reread stream. No unrelated DATA payload, alternate stream, reparse target or OS path is opened.
aliases: Before any nonresident target-list payload read, validate complete mapping/allocation and reject self-overlap or aliasing with boot, mirror, the complete MFT DATA map, all known MFT/Volume/directory/earlier-target lists and selected directory allocation/bitmap runs. Later target lists cross-check all earlier ranges. Never defer alias validation until after the payload read. This is selected metadata disjointness, not global cluster ownership.
correspondence: For each edge compare its full parent reference, original UTF16LE name bytes and namespace byte against distinct filename instances from that exact target base. The namespace comparison is an explicit exact-tuple prototype policy, not an asserted proof of complete NTFS lookup semantics. Preserve all names, instances, parents, opaque original values and hashes. Do not normalize, render, merge aliases, compare opaque duplicated-information fields as identity, or collapse distinct identical instances. Report exact matching-instance count and link the edge to the bounded original target inventory. Use a finite exact-key lookup per target to avoid a quadratic edge-by-all-name scan; its binary ordering is internal and claims no NTFS collation.
summaries: Empty indexes complete with zero targets/edges. A fully acquired valid target inventory with no exact edge correspondence is an observed mismatch: continue independent safe comparisons, retain exact matched/unmatched counts and finish source rereads. Then complete=true and applicable=false with ntfs_membership_name_mismatch. One or more identical matching instances establishes exact correspondence only; uniqueness, collation and namespace remain unverified. Missing/stale/unsupported/malformed target/list evidence, read failure, source change or quota stops produce a bounded incomplete prefix and no aggregate applicability. Collection/comparison completeness, exact correspondence and final source-reread equality remain separate properties; local prefixes never establish current-source authority.
outputs: org.disked.ntfs-membership-observation-prototype/1 owns existing bootstrap/directory observations plus requested membership controls, bounded target/name inventories, edge correspondence, exact prefix/total counts and original hashes. Preserve native/source/process authority distinctions: supplied source_id/epoch are assertions, equal rereads are not an atomic snapshot, and atomic_snapshot/current_source_authority/effects_authorized remain false. Keep namespace/collation/lookup/tree/content unverified. This is a private review model, not a stable storage or public protocol ABI. Every comparison row identifies the original header_number and target full reference/inventory, with matching-instance count. A target row may retain an incomplete source/closure/inventory prefix when its callback fails; the top-level source diagnostic remains authoritative for reader/budget failures.
budgets: All source read/byte/retention/attribute/run/output quotas remain global across bootstrap, graph and all targets/extensions/lists. Keep the existing individual-read49152 maximum and private filename limits derived from the current capture limits. Bound target arrays before insertion/read, charge variable target/edge report retention before appending it, retain finite copied-byte/typed-edge storage and enforce final JSON output cap. Duplicate-reference caching cannot evade counters or retain unbounded data. Document algorithmic memory bounds separately from unavailable OS heap enforcement. Target source records receive a fixed header/closure reserve before read/parse; each target inventory is charged once before attaching its JSON. Typed exact-name lookup storage is bounded by consumed attribute/name bytes and count, separately from serialized-report charges. No cross-phase cache is required merely to avoid repeat reads of already observed FILEs.
validation: Independently enrich generated directory fixtures with protected target FILEs and resident/nonresident filename lists before evaluation. Predict exact source requests/order/bytes/hashes and raw correspondence independently of product output. Cover both versions, root/nonroot/empty/deep/fragmented graphs, several names/parents/DOS aliases, identical instances and duplicate targets, raw NUL/control/surrogate/max names, differing opaque fields, known no-match with complete comparison, and directory/file target flags. Exercise stale/zero/conflicting references, extension-as-base, wrong owner/instance/optional ordinal, malformed/bound/list gaps and every selected physical alias before payload reads. Test exact/exceeded target/read/byte/retention/attribute/list/run/output limits, missing dependencies, every read/final-reread failure/change, mutated controls/callback buffers and owned outputs. Preserve exact old bootstrap/directory read order and all existing stream/name/public outcomes. Require a fresh all-target/full-current native campaign, headers/imports/boundaries/source map, tooling/context/manifest and implementing-agent review. Native file/worker/public transport admission remains separately tested work.
